status_at_registration: construction complete; no registered confirmation executed
purpose: Test a reference-normalized spectral interface for nondestructive material estimation and fresh spatial-defect reconstruction without estimating common source-gain histories.

K1.input: Simultaneous sample/open-beam/dark observations at 50,100,150 keV; no material truth provided to estimator.
K1.output: Aluminum/copper mass areal density (g/cm^2), conditional deterministic component bounds and abstention diagnostics.
K1.physical_model: Ideal narrow-beam monochromatic Beer-Lambert attenuation using NIST SRD126 coefficients.
K1.binding_model_nuisance: Arbitrary positive source gain shared by sample/reference in each energy/ray, plus measured dark offset.
K1.construction: Subtract dark, form log(reference)-log(sample), apply full-rank three-energy/two-material decoder; check orthogonal residual and nonnegativity intervals.
K1.exact_bound: With each corrected signal independently within relative eps<1 of its ideal value, each log-ratio error is at most log((1+eps)/(1-eps)); multiply by decoder row one-norms.
not_covered: unmeasured dark error outside declared corrected-signal envelope
K1.acceptance: All 192 estimates accepted and within declared component bounds. Analytic maximum error <=1e-10 g/cm^2. Strong comparator must agree within1e-10. This qualifies only model-conditional implementation, never physical accuracy.

K2.different_function: Reconstruct spatial aluminum/copper density and localize an interior low-density cell from multi-angle rays; K1 only answers integrated material quantities.
K2.why_consequential_if_physically_qualifie: Nondestructive spatial defect localization serves structural qualification whereas integrated composition cannot locate a defect. This is potential consequence, not an established new industry.
K2.new_construction: Ray/cell path-length matrix, full-rank spatial inversion, propagated density intervals and localization decision.
K2.retained: Frozen spectral normalization, coefficient basis, decoder, residual and uncertainty contract; no K2 truth or precomputed answers.
K2.task_family: 16 fresh authored four-by-four Al/Cu density grids, one strongly depleted cell, nine angles and eleven offsets (99 rays), cell width0.25cm.
K2.acceptance: All16 geometries full rank, all16 outputs accepted and within propagated intervals, and all16 depleted cells correctly localized. This is grid-model qualification, not physical porosity metrology.
controls: no inheritance recompiles spectral interface with same facts
equal-content ordinary reuse via standard flat-field/log plus independent SVD
K2.retained_advantage_rule: No algorithmic/discovery advantage if ordinary or no-inheritance controls tie. Saved implementation content is distinct from a better discovery procedure. No invented human-hours benchmark.

failure_tests: A one-g/cm^2 unmodeled iron layer must reject through spectral residual.
A coherent sample/reference gain mismatch equivalent to +[0.2,0.03]g/cm^2 is expected to evade residual detection; record as an explicit scope failure, never universal fault-detection success.

truth_access.constructor_inputs: Only declared spectra/geometry/current observation arrays and uncertainty envelope.
truth_access.authored_truth: The developer authored the fixture family and public seeds. This is not a blinded external trial. Function-level data-flow separation does not make shared-host truth cryptographically hidden.
truth_access.independent_adversary: Separate portfolio verifier specifies additional cases. Route constructor does not inspect verifier hidden files/seeds/truth.

baseline: Competent conventional engineer allowed identical calibration, spectral/reference channels, source facts and geometry; standard flat-field/log decomposition and least-squares reconstruction. Expected tie is retained.

business.offer: Prospective industrial inspection software/qualification integration; no physical production or actual customer established.
business.price_and_market: Uncalibrated authored scenarios recorded separately; buyer refusal against incumbent XCT, in-house reconstruction and no purchase required.
business.finance: Root integrates all route scenarios using existing JournalAccount and adaptive Account. This route creates no replacement ledger or operating account.
business.capital: Compare non-entry, staged entry,100000USD, relevant1000000000USD hypothesis and justified intermediate scales; received committed funds must be accounted natively.
business.earned_K2: Unestablished at scientific registration; no inferred earned funding.
business.human_baseline: Conventional software retains machine-speed linear algebra. No observed human baseline hours, autonomous model token count, actual industrial billing, or physical qualification labor measured.

measurement: Wall/CPU seconds and exact executed case counts; zero human intervention inside deterministic run, upstream user direction unmeasured; deployment costs are estimates and actual host/model billing unknown.
stopping: One finite registered192-case K1/16-case K2 pass plus specified failure cases; preserve bounded negative/tie. Any corrected protocol gets a prospective amendment and new identity before rerun; do not tune this confirmation to success.
publication: Only original research code, tiny numeric reference extract with source attribution, authored fixtures and qualified results. No private prompt, conversation, data or account authority.
